description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange w.e.f. 05.01.2026 to 11.01.2026
reasoning: The gazette content is a Customs Notification issued under the Customs Ordinance, specifying new official exchange rates for calculating duties and charges. It is a regulatory instrument issued by a government official (the Director General of Customs) exercising statutory powers. This falls squarely under the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5), which include "statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation" and "regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements." The priority rules do not apply here as the core content is not about government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) but about establishing a binding regulatory requirement.
